entries.title: Hear a demo's sound when it matters
entries.body: A crewmate's demo recording can now keep its sound when the demo is about something you need to hear, such as a new alert or a voice-over. Every other demo stays silent. A demo with sound says so on its button, Play · 12 s · sound, and its sound plays only when you press Play, stopping any card's sound clip that was playing.

picture.alt: A maximized note with a narration clip's Listen button, and under it a demo's poster whose button reads Play · 3 s · sound
